python3 - <<'PY'
import json, os
from datetime import datetime, timezone, timedelta
TZ = timezone(timedelta(hours=8))
day = "2026-11-03"
paths = [
  os.path.expanduser("~/Library/Application Support/youchu-agent-bus/state/youchu_ai_inbox.jsonl"),
  os.path.expanduser("~/Library/Application Support/youchu-agent-bus/state/youchu_ai_sent.json"),
]
# inbox
p = paths[0]
if os.path.exists(p):
  n=0
  with open(p) as f:
    for line in f:
      try: o=json.loads(line)
      except: continue
      ts = o.get("created_at") or o.get("ts") or o.get("time") or ""
      text = (o.get("text") or o.get("body") or o.get("message") or "")[:200]
      if day in str(ts) or day.replace("-","") in str(ts):
        print("IN", o.get("bus_id") or o.get("id"), ts, text[:120].replace("\n"," "))
        n+=1
        if n>15: break
  print("inbox matches", n)
else:
  print("no inbox", p)
PY
